name: Focused invalidation boundary comparison

arms.original: Full divergence interval wick extreme + frozen 0.5 ATR
arms.local6: Last 6 closed bars including trigger (t-5..t) wick extreme + same frozen 0.5 ATR
arms.local2: Endpoint and trigger bars (t-1..t) wick extreme + same frozen 0.5 ATR

unchanged: Saved MACD Hist raw signal spans, turn and line check, close confirmation, full-interval reversal target, one active event, resolve then same-close restart, no timeout
paired: For every baseline event start compare first close resolution under alternative boundary on identical future; count baseline successes converted to early failures. This is a counterfactual comparison, not extra tradable events.
stream: Separately replay each arm and count accepted starts, ignored raw signal bars, genuinely new reference groups, occupied bars and completed wait distributions. Pending excluded from completed accuracy, reported separately.
decision: Do not automatically replace baseline. A boundary is eligible for a proposed default only if both full timeframes reduce occupied bars at least 20%, sacrifice no more than 5% of baseline successes in paired comparison, and recent periods do not contradict that tradeoff. These are engineering acceptance criteria, not evidence of profitability.
limits: Already inspected historical snapshot through 2026-10-15 UTC; recent period diagnostic not unseen holdout. No leverage, P&L or trading orders. Native saved data matching Pine baseline; keep anomaly history, do not silently clean.
